2.4.1.v: All affixes after the verb गाङ् 'to study' and the verb कुट् 'to be crooked' and the rest, are as if they had an indicatory ङ् (ङित्), except those affixes which have an indicatory ञ् (ञित्) or ण् (णित्).

2.4.2.v: An affix which begins with the augment इट् -- आर्धधातुकस्येड् वलादेः [[7.2.35]], is ङित् after the root विज् 'to fear, to move'.

2.4.3.v: A द्वन्द compound or words signifying persons belonging to the different Vedic-schools, when the sense is that of repetition is singular.

2.4.4.v: A द्वन्द compound of words denoting क्रतु (sacrifices) ordained by यजुर् (अध्वर्यु) Veda, is singular, provided they are never used in the neuter gender

2.4.5.v: A द्वन्द compound of words denoting (persons who have studied) subjects, which in their order of study are not remote from each other, is singular.

2.4.6.v: A द्वन्द compound of words signifying जाति (genus) which are not the names of living beings, is singular.

2.4.7.v: A द्वन्द compound of words of different genders, denoting names of rivers and countries, but not of towns, is singular.

2.4.8.v: A द्वन्द compound of words signifying small animals, is singular.

2.4.9.v: A द्वन्द compound of words signifying those animals only among whom there is permanent enmity i.e. natural and eternal antipathy or quarrel, is singular.

2.4.10.v: A द्वन्द compound of words denoting those classes of शुद्रा-s who have not been expelled from the communion of higher classes, is singular.

2.4.11.v: The word गवाश and others are also द्वन्द compounds which take the singular number.

2.4.12.v: A द्वन्द compound of words being the names of trees, wild animals, grass, corn, condiment, domestic beasts and birds and the compounds अश्व-वडव , पूर्व-पर and अधरोत्तर , are optionally singular.

2.4.13.v: A द्वन्द compound of words of contrary significations, but not being the names of concrete substances.

2.4.14.v: The द्वन्द compounds like दधिपय etc. are not singular.

2.4.15.v: A द्वन्द compound denoting a fixed number (एकत्व) of concrete things (अधिकरण) is not singular.

2.4.16.v: A द्वन्द compound denoting an approximate number of concrete substances, is optionally singular.

2.4.17.v: It, namely the द्विगु or द्वन्द compound, with regard to which singular number has been ordained by the above rules, is always neuter gender.

2.4.18.v: An अव्ययीभाव -- अव्ययं विभक्तिसमीपसमृद्धिव्यृद्ध्यर्थाभावात्ययासम्प्रतिशब्दप्रादुर्भावपश्चाद्यथाऽऽनुपूर्व्ययौगपद्यसादृश्यसम्पत्तिसाकल्यान्तवचनेषु [[2.1.6]], compound is also neuter gender.

2.4.19.v: A तत्-पुरुष compound, with the exception of that which is formed by the particle नञ् , and or the कर्मधारय compound, becomes neuter gender, in the cases explained in the following sūtras.

2.4.20.v: When denoting an appellative, a तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word कन्था 'town', is neuter in gender, provided that it is the name of a town situated in a country of the उशीनर-s.

2.4.21.v: A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the words उपज्ञा 'invention' and उपक्रम 'commencement' is neuter in gender, when it is intended to express the starting point of a work which is first invented or commenced.

2.4.22.v: A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word छाया 'shadow' in neuter in gender when the sense is that of profuseness of the thing indicated by the first term.

2.4.23.v: A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word सभा 'court' is neuter, provided that it is preceded by (a word synonymous with) the word राजा or by a word denoting a non-human-being.

2.4.24.v: A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word सभा 'court', when it does not mean a house but means concourse, is neuter.

2.4.25.v: A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the words सेना 'army', सुरा 'wine', छाया 'shadow', शाला 'house' and निशा 'night', is optionally neuter, with the exception of that which is formed by the particle नञ् -- नञ् [[2.2.6]], and the कर्मधारय compound.

2.4.26.v: The gender of द्वन्द compound or तत्-पुरुष compound is like that of the last word in it.

2.4.27.v: The gender of the compound of the word अश्व 'horse' and वडव 'a mare', is like that of the first word in it.

2.4.28.v: Of the compounds हेमन्त-शिशिरौ and अहोरात्रे , the gender is like that of the first word, in the छन्दस् ।

2.4.29.v: The द्वन्द and तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the words रात्र and अह्न are spoken of in masculine.

2.4.30.v: The तत्-पुरुष word अपथम् 'a bad road', is neuter.

2.4.31.v: The words अर्धर्च etc. are spoken of in masculine and neuter.

2.4.32.v: In the room of इदम् 'this', in the case of its re-employment in a subsequent member of the same sentence and referring to the same thing (अन्वादेश) there is the substitution of अश् which is अनुदात्त (gravely accented), when the Instrumental -3rd case-affix and the rest follow.

2.4.33.v: In the room of एतद् in the case of re-employment there is the substitution of the gravely accented अश् when the affixes त्र -- सप्तम्यास्त्रल् [[5.3.10]] and तस् -- पञ्चम्यास्तसिल् [[5.3.7]] follow, and the affixes त्र and तद् are अनुदात्त (gravely accented) also.

2.4.34.v: When an affix of the Accusative -2nd case or टा - Instrumental -3rd case singular or ओश् Locative -7th-case dual follows, एन् which is अनुदात्त is the substitute of इदम् and its re-employment.

2.4.35.v: The clause 'when the affix is आर्धधातुक is understood in the following sūtras up to sūtra [[2.4.58]].

2.4.36.v: The word जग्धि is the substitute of अद् 'to eat', when the affix ल्यप् -- समासेऽनञ्पूर्वे क्त्वो ल्यप् [[7.1.37]] or an आर्धधातुक कित् affix beginning with a त follows.

2.4.37.v: When लुङ् (Aorist) or सन् (Desiderative) follows घसॢ is the substitute of अद् 'to eat'.

2.4.38.v: And when the affix घञ् and अप् follow घसॢ is the substitute of अद्।

2.4.39.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), घसॢ is diversely substituted for अद्।

2.4.40.v: When लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows घसॢ is optionally the substitute of अद्।

2.4.41.v: When लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows, वयि is optionally the substitute follows of वेञ् 'to weave'.

2.4.42.v: बध् is the substitute of हन् 'to kill' when the आर्धधातुक लिङ् (Benedictive) follows.

2.4.43.v: And when लुङ् (Aorist) follows वध is the substitute of हन्।

2.4.44.v: When आत्मनेपद affixes follow, वध् is optionally the substitute of हन् in the लुङ् (Aorist).

2.4.45.v: गा is the substitute of the root इण् when लुङ् (Aorist) follows.

2.4.46.v: When the affix णि (causal follows, गामि is the substitute of इण् when the sense is not that of 'informing' but that of 'going'.

2.4.47.v: And when सन् (Desiderative) follows, गमि is the substitute of ण् when the sense is not that of 'informing'.

2.4.48.v: And of इङ् 'to study', गमि is the substitute when सन् follows.

2.4.49.v: गाम् is the substitute of इङ् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

2.4.50.v: गाङ् is optionally the substitute of इङ् when लुङ् (Aorist) and ऌङ् (Conditional Future) follow.

2.4.51.v: गाङ् is optionally the substitute of इङ् is the causative णि , when that causative takes the affix सन् (Desiderative) and चन् (Aorist).

2.4.52.v: भू is the substitute of the verb अस् 'to be' when an आर्धधातुक affix is to be applied.

2.4.53.v: वचि is the substitute of ब्रू 'to speak' when any आर्धधातुक affix is to be supplied.

2.4.54.v: ख्याञ् is the substitute of चक्षिङ् 'to perceive, to tell', when any आर्धधातुक affix is to be applied.

2.4.55.v: ख्याञ् is optionally the substitute of चक्षिङ् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

2.4.56.v: वी is the substitute of the verb अज् 'to drive', 'to lead', when an आर्धधातुक affix follows, with the exception of the affixes घञ् -- भावे [[3.3.18]] and अप् -- समुदोरजः पशुषु [[3.3.69]].

2.4.57.v: वी is optionally the substitute of अज् when the affix -- अनद्यतने लुट् [[3.3.15]] etc. follows.

2.4.58.v: After a word ending with the गोत्र affix ण्य -- कुर्वादिभ्यो ण्यः [[4.1.151]] and after a गोत्र word denoting the descendant of a क्षत्रिय or a ऋषि 'seer' and after a word ending with a गोत्र affix having an indicatory ञ् , the affix ञ् , the affix अण् and इञ् employed in the forming युवन् -- जीवति तु वंश्ये युवा [[4.1.163]], descendants, are elided by the substitution of लुक्।

2.4.59.v: And after the words पैल etc. there is the लुक् elision of the युवन् affix.

2.4.60.v: After a word ending in the गोत्र affix -- [[4.1.95]], there is elision of लुक् of the युवन् affix, when the गोत्र of the people called प्राच्य 'Eastern' is denoted.

2.4.61.v: After the words तौल्वलि and the rest, there is no लुक् elision of the युवन् affix.

2.4.62.v: There is लुक् elision of तद्राज -- ते तद्राजाः [[4.1.174]], affix, when the word is used in the plural number, provided that the plural number is taken by the base itself and not by its standing as a compound epithet dependent upon another word and provided that the base is not used in the feminine.

2.4.63.v: After the word यस्क etc. there is the लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix when the word of itself and not as part of a compound epithet dependent on another word, takes the plural; but not in the feminine.

2.4.64.v: And there is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix यञ् -- गर्गादिभ्यो यञ् [[4.1.105]] and अञ् -- अनृष्यानन्तर्ये बिदादिभ्योऽञ् [[4.1.104]], when the word of itself and not as part of a compound epithet dependent on another, takes the plural, but not in the feminine.

2.4.65.v: After the words अत्रि , भृगु , कुत्स , वशिष्ठ , गोतम , अङ्गिरस , there is elision of the गोत्र affix, when the word takes the plural, but not in the feminine.

2.4.66.v: And there is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix इञ् -- गोत्राद्यून्यस्त्रियाम् [[4.1.95]] after a word containing many vowels (a poly-syllabic word) which denotes the गोत्र of the people called प्राच्य and भरत when the word takes the plural.

2.4.67.v: After the words गोपवन etc. there is not लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix, when the word takes the plural.

2.4.68.v: After the words तिक , कितब etc. when used as द्वन्द compound, there is the लुक् elision of the गोत्र affixes when the compound word takes the plural.

2.4.69.v: After the words उपक etc. there is optionally लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix when the words take the plural whether they enter into द्वन्द compound or are used separately.

2.4.70.v: There is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affixes अण् and यञ् of the words अगस्त्य , and कौणडिन्य , when they take the plural and the words अगस्ति and कण्डिनच् are the substitutes of the bases so remaining after the elision.

2.4.71.v: There is लुक् elision of the case-affix of a word when it gets the name of धातु 'root' or is of a crude form.
2.4.71.e: A सुप् प्रत्यय that comes as a part of a धातु or a प्रातिपदिक is removed.
2.4.71.sa: धातोः प्रातिपदिकस्य वा अवयवरूपेण विद्यमानस्य सुप्-प्रत्ययस्य लुक् भवति ।
2.4.71.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

2.4.72.v: After the verb अद् 'to eat' and the rest there is लुक् elision of the विकरण शप् -- कर्तरि शप् [[3.1.68]].
2.4.72.sa: अदादिगणस्य धातुभ्यः विहितस्य शप्-प्रत्ययस्य लुक् भवति ।
2.4.72.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

2.4.73.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) there is diversely the लुक् elision of the विकरण शप् -- कर्तरि शप् [[3.1.68]].

2.4.74.v: And there is diversely the लुक् elision of यङ् -- धातोरेकाचो हलादेः क्रियासमभिहारे यङ् [[3.1.22]], when the affix अच् -- नन्दिग्रहिपचादिभ्यो ल्युणिन्यचः [[3.1.134]], follows.

2.4.75.v: After the verbs हू 'to sacrifice' and others there is श्लु elision of the विकरण शप् -- कर्तरि शप् [[3.1.68]].

2.4.76.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) there is elision of the शप् diversely.

2.4.77.v: There is लुक् elision of the affix सिच् -- च्लेः सिच् [[3.1.44]] in the परस्मैपद after the verbs गा 'to go', स्था 'to stand', the verbs called घु मृषस्तितिक्षायाम् [[1.2.20]], पा 'to drink' and भू 'to be'.
2.4.77.e: For the verb roots गा, स्था, पा, भू and the verb roots referred as  'घु', the सिच्-विकरण is removed when followed by the  प्रत्यय of परस्मैपद.
2.4.77.sa: गा, स्था, पा, भू एतेभ्यः परस्य तथा घुसंज्ञकधातुभ्यः परस्य सिच्-विकरणस्य परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्यये परे लुक् भवति ।
2.4.77.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

2.4.78.v: After the verbs घ्रा 'to smell', धेट् 'to drink', शा (शो) 'to pare' छा (छो) 'to cut' and सा (सो) 'to destroy' there is optionally the elision of सिच् when the परस्मैपद terminations are used.
2.4.78.e: For the verbs घ्रा, धेट्, शो, छो and सो, the सिच्-प्रत्यय is removed optionally when followed by a प्रत्यय of परस्मैपद.
2.4.78.sa: घ्रा, धेट्, शो, छो, सो - एतेषां परस्य सिच्-प्रत्ययस्य परस्मैपदेषु विकल्पेन लुक् भवति ।
2.4.78.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

2.4.79.v: After the verbs तन् 'to expand' and others there is optionally the लुक् elision of सिच् when the आत्मनेपद affixes त and थास् of the 2nd Person follow.

2.4.80.v: In the मन्त्र portion of the Vedas there is लुक् elision of the sign of the Aorist (& लिट् -Perfect Tense) after the verbs घस् 'to eat', हूर् 'to be crooked', णश् 'to destroy', वृ 'to choose, to cover', दह् 'to burn', verbs ending in long आ , वृच् 'to avoid', कृ 'to make', गमि 'to go' and जनि 'to be produced'.

2.4.81.v: There is लुक् elision in the room of that tense-affix (लि) which comes after आम् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense).
2.4.81.e: The लकार that follows the 'आम्' प्रत्यय is removed.
2.4.81.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

2.4.82.v: There is लुक् elision of आप् (the feminine termination) and सुप् (the case-affixes) after an अव्यय or indeclinable.
2.4.82.e: The आप्-प्रत्ययाः and the सुप्-प्रत्ययाः attached to an अव्यय are removed by doing a लुक्.
2.4.82.sa: अव्ययात् परस्य आप्-प्रत्ययानाम् सुप्-प्रत्ययानाम् च लुक्-भवति ।
2.4.82.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

2.4.83.v: There is not लुक् elision of the case-affix after an अव्ययीभाव compound that ends in अ ; आम् is the substitute of its case-affix es, but not when it is the 5th case-affix.

2.4.84.v: The change to अम् of the Instrumental -3rd case and Locative -7th-case-affixes coming after an अव्ययीभाव compound that ends in अ , occurs diversely.

2.4.85.v: डा , रौ and रस् are substituted respectively in the room of the three-affixes of the 3rd Person of लुट् (First Future), both in the परस्मैपद and आत्मनेपद।
2.4.85.e: The प्रथमपुरुष प्रत्ययाः of लुट्-लकार are converted respectively to डा, रौ and रस्.
2.4.85.sa: लुट्-लकारस्य प्रथमपुरुषस्य प्रत्ययानाम् (क्रमेण) डा, रौ, रस्  - एते आदेशाः भवन्ति ।
2.4.85.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation
